title: [security] Family closeout: stored metadata bodies (stored datasource credential material included) are still reachable outside the redacting doors at several further positions — detail withheld pending maintainer
body:
Filing gate: **① reproducible defects with named landing sites**, folded into ONE family closeout card as the same-family rule requires (no single-point cards). `reach:` exception — could leak data. Measured in-session on fresh showcase boots by the #21086 dev, after that fix. Reader: the maintainer, who holds the positions and recipes; dispatched directly at the maintainer's request. Dedupe: this is the closeout of the #7990 / #20590 / #13405 / #21086 family (all closed except #21086, whose PR #21115 is in review); a family-level search (open + closed) finds no open card covering these positions.

QA-source: #21056 · integration-system.datasource-credential-refusal-matrix · negative[0]

## What is known publicly

- Stored metadata bodies, including stored datasource credential material, are declared write-only. They are redacted on the `/meta` and datasource doors and, once PR #21115 lands, on the generic data door's reads of the stored metadata tables.
- Further positions remain where a stored body (or a value derived from it) can still be served, kept or recovered outside those doors. All positions measured so far are admin-reachable only:
  - a read surface that serves the body directly;
  - a write path that keeps an at-rest cleartext copy of the body in a second admin-readable store, whose fix needs a writer change AND a migration of existing rows;
  - a query shape on the generic data door that still evaluates the stored body;
  - one position that is unmeasured and must be measured first.
- The maintainer has ruled on the query-shape position: the generic data door **refuses** it on the stored metadata tables (a further accept-set narrowing, the same family as #21115's grouping refusal). Ruling, verbatim (Claude Code session `session_01MRdbfpy4sQT8bUjmMhxsN7`, 2026-10-01): 「A 拒绝（推荐）」. Decision to file and dispatch this card, verbatim from the same session: 「立一张脱敏收口卡并派发（推荐）」.

**Detail withheld pending maintainer** (RUNNER rule 2).

## Acceptance (family level)

- An enumeration pin over every surface that can serve, copy or evaluate a stored metadata body. Each surface is either covered by the shared redaction seam or refused there, so that a future surface fails the pin instead of joining the family silently.
- Each measured position fixed at its own landing, through the one shared redaction seam. No second redaction dialect.
- Existing at-rest copies migrated.
- The unmeasured position measured, and then fixed or recorded with evidence.
